highlights: Create and revise reliefs with editable components, vector masks, sculpting and rail profiles. CNC preview uses the revised surface.
Save CNC setups and cutting presets, preview machining-template changes, plan quantities across sheets and export setup documents.
Edit constrained sketches and parametric parts, prepare two-sided CNC work, and review tapered inlays, predicted remaining stock and tool-reach warnings.
Dense laser G-code previews use finer cutting lines and less prominent travel lines. Laser job previews start with travel hidden, and active playback strokes remain visible over flat cuts.
SVG imports follow declared sizes, percentages and clipping; new KerfDesk artwork exports retain scene placement. Cut planning preserves holes and islands across different artwork settings.
Find omitted open contours in Job Review and select affected artwork for repair. Controller incidents remain available during the session and in support reports.
